doc_title: Meridian Ridge Global Opportunities Fund, L.P. — PPM
notes: Clean, well-structured open-end hedge fund PPM. Terms stated once, in the section where an analyst would expect them. Tests plain retrieval across a long document plus two-class handling.

fund_name.expected: Meridian Ridge Global Opportunities Fund, L.P.

fund_structure.expected: Open-end Delaware LP in a master-feeder structure; feeds into a Cayman master fund

management_fee.expected: Class A 1.75% per annum; Class B 1.25% per annum, on NAV of capital account, accrued monthly / paid quarterly in arrears

performance_fee.expected: 20% of Net Profits, identical for Class A and Class B

hurdle_rate.expected: None — performance allocation is expressly not subject to a hurdle, preferred return or benchmark

high_water_mark.expected: Yes — perpetual, per-investor Loss Carryforward Account; reduced pro rata on partial redemption; does not reset

lockup_period.expected: Class A 12 months; Class B 24 months; FIFO per subscription. Early redemption permitted with GP consent subject to 3% fee

redemption_frequency.expected: Quarterly — last business day of each calendar quarter

gate_provision.expected: Fund-level gate at 20% of NAV per Redemption Date; excess reduced pro rata and carried forward with priority

key_man_provision.expected: Yes — Dr. Elena Vasquez-Hartmann. On a Key Man Event, LPs may redeem next quarter-end free of lock-up, early redemption fee and the Gate, on 30 days' notice

gp_commitment.expected: Greater of $25,000,000 or 2% of aggregate Master Fund NAV, maintained for so long as the Partnership operates

fund_term.expected: Perpetual — open-end, no fixed termination date, no investment period

prime_broker.expected: Harrington Sloan Securities LLC and Beaumont Clarke International Ltd.

legal_counsel.expected: Whitlock Barr & Nunes LLP (U.S.); Kentish Drummond (Cayman)

mfn_election.expected: No — the Partnership expressly does not offer an MFN election
